experiment: P2w explicit VFT component-isolation oracle sufficiency
single_mechanism_change: Replace the composite observation by the exact, generator-reconstructed and power-calibrated VFT component only for an oracle sufficiency screen; no classifier, router, separator, threshold, or full-12 attachment is trained or changed.
question: Does explicit VFT component isolation provide sufficient physical information for the frozen reference-aligned Doppler estimator on weak compound observations?
why_new: P2u signed-grid and P2v phase-increment oracle candidates are insufficient on near OOD. This screen introduces a distinct observation: the actual isolated VFT component reconstructed from train-only component seeds. The seeds are unavailable at deployment and are oracle targets only.

fresh_data.identity_contract: all three powers of an identity remain in one seed pool; no pool may overlap any historic generated train identity

frozen_estimator.target: VFT Doppler parameter column 49; evaluate only finite, VFT-positive rows

controls.C0_raw_composite: frozen estimator on observed composite I/Q
controls.C1_exact_isolated_component_oracle: same estimator on VFT component reconstructed with component seed and stored calibrated target power
controls.C2_wrong_reference: C1 with chirp rate multiplied by 0.8
controls.C3_no_delay_alignment: C1 with search_delay=false and delay fixed to zero

metrics: C1 versus C2/C3 mechanism-control MAE ratio
stop_rule: If any oracle gate fails, stop VFT component-separator and deeper-router search on this observable family. If all gates pass, freeze this oracle result and preregister a distinct train-only supervised separator study on a new identity pool; never use component seeds, oracle components, labels, or parameters at deployment.
